findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: REPEAT. Inspector observed the caulking along the back of the mop sink to be cracked and in need of repair. Discussed with PIC, and PIC said they would make note of it for maintenance. ensure this area is sealed, so that no moisture can get behind the sink basin, and the caulking is smooth, durable, and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
A mop was observed to be stored in the mop bucket with a small amount of water at the bottom.  Discussed with employee, corrected on site.  Ensure mops are stored in a position to air dry.

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Caulk around the top of the mop basin along the wall is cracked and missing in some places.  Re-caulk or reseal mop basin along the wall to create a smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable surface.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.
